sheet.title: Build decks
sheet.intro: Builds the evolution line, adds the Trainers and support Pokémon today’s top decks play, and the Energy your attacks need — your cards first, at each budget, plus a recent tournament list when one plays your card. Basic Energy uses your actual collection quantities and purchase prices.
